subfiles.title: List of Papers: Merchant Vessels—Japan, entries 535–549
subfiles.about: A two-page register summarizes State Department papers concerning Japanese merchant shipping and related American commercial interests.
subfiles.summary: Register lists 1939 reports (plus an earlier 1938 one) on Japanese shipping conditions, freight-rate discrimination against American President Lines, proposed international services, Japan-China coastal consolidation under Toa Kaiun Kaisha, and December 1939 launchings of the Sakura Maru and Kokoku Maru at Nagasaki.

interest: Shows 1939 U.S. monitoring of Japanese shipping subsidies, freight-rate practices, and route expansion before the Pacific War.
